guide.intro: Create a private draft and complete eight focused sections. Nothing is published or treated as a contract.
help.contractor_exact_json_a: Select the unchanged saved requirement file supplied by the client.
help.contractor_existing_account: Enter the email of an existing active demonstration member. The platform does not search or publish a member directory.
help.invitation_code_required: The invitation link does not contain this code. Enter the code supplied by the client.
help.json_b_business_data: Fill in the work, price, responsibilities, and review terms below.
help.pages_format: One page per line: title | purpose | content items separated by commas.
help.references_format: One site per line: full URL | reason.
help.reject_invitation: Rejecting closes this invitation without granting case access.
help.upload_exact_registered_json_a: Select the unchanged saved requirement file previously downloaded from this case. The preview does not store another copy.
help.upload_exact_registered_json_a_agai: Select the same saved requirement file again. Invitation creation verifies it in the same protected request.
notice.candidate_not_formal: This version is ready for review but is not final yet.
notice.candidate_same_saved_bytes: Both case parties preview and download the same saved agreement PDF and scope diagram.
notice.case_discussion_append_only: Earlier messages and issue history remain visible. A correction adds a new record without hiding what came before.
notice.confirmation_statement: I confirm this exact saved agreement, proposal, PDF, and scope diagram.
notice.delivery_formal_bound: Every delivery and inspection record is bound to this unchanged formal version.
notice.delivery_limit_next_step: The fixed history remains available. The parties may open a dispute and export evidence; this PoC will not create a twenty-first delivery version.
notice.delivery_limit_reached: The 20-version delivery limit has been reached.
notice.delivery_version_limit: This competition build supports up to 20 immutable delivery versions per case.
notice.email_unavailable: Email Delivery Is Not Available in This PoC
notice.evidence_scope: The export contains the formal five-file evidence set and submitted delivery history. Private drafts, credentials, sessions, and unrelated cases are excluded.
notice.exact_json_a_required: The imported file must exactly match the saved requirement registered for this invitation.
notice.explicit_acceptance: I explicitly accept every listed item in this delivery. Silence and deadlines do not count as acceptance.
notice.explicit_acceptance_recorded: Explicit client acceptance is recorded for the current delivery and inspection.
notice.formal_same_saved_bytes: This confirmed agreement uses the exact files both parties reviewed.
notice.import_does_not_trust_authority: Identity, role, status, and server time come from the signed-in account and current database state, never from the uploaded file.
notice.invitation_code_not_in_url: The one-time code is not included in the invitation URL.
notice.invitation_code_once: This code is shown only on this creation result. If it is lost, revoke the pending invitation and create another one.
notice.invitation_minimum_summary: Before acceptance, only the minimum invitation identity is shown. Requirement content remains private.
notice.invitation_private: Creating this invitation does not publish the requirement. Only the designated account can review and respond.
notice.invitation_seven_days: The invitation expires seven days after the server creates it.
notice.json_b_draft_private: Only you can see this proposal draft. The client can see it after you send it for review.
notice.json_b_exact_bytes: Download your saved proposal, then upload the same file here to share it with the client for review.
notice.json_b_review_read_only: This review version is fixed. An objection creates an issue and does not edit these bytes.
notice.json_b_server_fields: The app adds the proposal number, connects it to this requirement, calculates totals, and records who is involved, its review status, and the submission dates.
notice.local_only: PoC data is stored only on this local computer and is not promised permanent retention.
notice.manifest_acknowledgement_statemen: I reviewed the listed source and file digests for this fixed candidate.
notice.manual_handoff: Email delivery is not provided. Give the contractor the local invitation link and one-time code through a channel you choose.
notice.no_auto_translation: User Content Is Not Automatically Translated
notice.no_implied_acceptance: Silence or Expiry Does Not Constitute Agreement
notice.no_implied_confirmation: Silence, delay, or quote expiry never counts as acknowledgement or confirmation.
notice.no_json_b_review: No proposal has been submitted for review.
notice.no_messages: No discussion messages have been added.
notice.no_platform_adjudication: The platform preserves both parties' records and does not decide breach, liability, damages, payment, or the dispute outcome.
notice.not_yet_contract: This Version Is Not Yet the Parties' Formal Agreement
notice.requirement_in_confirmed_agreemen: This saved requirement is included in the confirmed agreement. Open the full agreement to review both parties' terms.
notice.one_confirmation_pending: Your confirmation is recorded. The version becomes final only after the other party confirms.
notice.reacknowledgement_required: Your prior confirmation was withdrawn. Review and acknowledge the same fixed candidate again before confirming it again.
notice.requirement_baseline_read_only: The client requirement is fixed for this proposal.
notice.review_confirm: I reviewed this draft and want to save this requirement version.
notice.revision_invalidates_candidate: This version is closed. Its files remain available for the record and cannot be confirmed.
notice.separate_proposal_fresh_scope: A new request starts as a separate empty proposal. It does not modify or copy the formal agreement.
notice.slice3_no_discussion: Discussion, issues, quotations, and payment are not available at this stage.
notice.source_matches_registered: The uploaded file matches the currently saved requirement.
pdf.fixed_original_notice: This PDF Is the Fixed Original Content
